background.$description: theme.colors.background → .v-application background. Slightly blue instead of the warm neutral palette. Dark uses secondary: primary is too saturated at low tones

on-background.$description: theme.colors.on-background → .v-application text color. Light text = dark background (secondary-10); dark text = primary-90, one tone below the light background. Contrast ≥ 13:1

shadow-key.$description: $shadow-key-color: rgba(var(--v-shadow-color), var(--v-shadow-key-opacity, 0.3)). Color of the 1st shadow in elevation/1–5

shadow-ambient.$description: $shadow-ambient-color: rgba(var(--v-shadow-color), var(--v-shadow-ambient-opacity, 0.15)). Color of the 2nd shadow in elevation/1–5

opacity.$description: Element opacity = --v-disabled-opacity: VField / inputs, checkbox, radio, switch, slider, otp, file upload, breadcrumbs
